text: nail's prog seeding leaves each round under <tmp-dir>/prog-seed/<round>/: pdb and pdb.index are the slice of the prefilter list mmseqs aligned that round, the next n_take targets of every still-active query (an inactive query has an empty entry); adb.* is the round's align result; report.txt is one line per query: 'key: hits_so_far | hits_in_round / n_take | fraction'. The union of the slices is every pair mmseqs aligned. Seen 7 Oct 2026, nail 0.7.1.
